/**
 * @name Identify potentially dangerous calls
 * @description Search for calls to eval, exec, and subprocess
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dangerous-calls
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "run"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Dangerous call detected"
findings.hypothesis: Check for any accidental usage of dangerous functions in the codebase.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect dynamic attribute access and exception handling
 * @description Checks for setattr usage and broad exception handling which can hide errors.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/aiosignal-inspection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 *       external/cwe/cwe-391
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Scope s
where
    // Check for setattr usage
    exists(Call c |
        c.getScope() = s and
        c.getFunc().(Name).getId() = "setattr"
    )
    or
    // Check for broad exception handling
    exists(ExceptStmt ex |
        ex.getScope() = s and
        (
            not exists(ex.getType()) or
            ex.getType().(Name).getId() = "Exception" or
            ex.getType().(Name).getId() = "BaseException"
        )
    )
select s, "Found potential area of interest: setattr usage or broad exception handling."
findings.hypothesis: The library might use unsafe dynamic attribute setting or suppress critical errors.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Broad exception handling
 * @description Catching Exception or BaseException without re-raising or logging can hide critical errors.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/broad-exception-handling
 * @tags error-handling
 *       external/cwe/cwe-393
 *       external/cwe/cwe-755
 */

import python

from ExceptStmt ex
where
    // Check if it catches generic Exception or BaseException
    exists(Name n | 
        ex.getType() = n and 
        (n.getId() = "Exception" or n.getId() = "BaseException")
    )
    and
    // And the body is empty or just pass/continue
    (
        not exists(ex.getBody()) or
        exists(Pass p | p = ex.getBody().getItem(0)) or
        exists(Continue c | c = ex.getBody().getItem(0))
    )
select ex, "Broad exception catch with empty or pass body."
findings.hypothesis: Broad exception swallowing might hide critical application errors.
